notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
description:
Cast Rograkh by paying commander tax, if applicable.
Rograkh enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Blessed Sanctuary.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Blessed Sanctuary, creating a 2/2 Unicron creature token.
The Unicorn enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
